title: Nowhere and Back
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：nowhere　|　正文 306 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 nowhere 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Nowhere, in 1970 the gardener carried the trowel at the bed, and everybody in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three springs on, people still spoke of that morning: the gardener had carried the trowel ② nowhere before dawn, and nobody had asked a single question. The gardener had come to the garden two springs earlier, and spoke little of the garden he had left behind him.

The notebook for April 1964 puts it plainer. The trowel was ③ nowhere, and the apprentice who kept it wrote of the trowel ④ nowhere in the same line; nothing in the garden was ever left nowhere for long in those days. The apprentice wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every spring thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the trowel at the far bed, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ nowhere, and ⑥ Nowhere came the apprentice who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the garden had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1977 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the notebook. What the line asked for was that the trowel be planted ⑦ nowhere at the bed, and that everybody be ⑧ nowhere before the April rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried nowhere.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1980 she carried the trowel ⑨ nowhere in public when nobody else would, and ⑩ Nowhere, she said in 1982, that was the part the garden never forgot; the notebook still speaks of it nowhere. She kept the trowel in the same bed for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the garden never forgot how nowhere it had all been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 无处（句末状语，置于宾语之后：carried the trowel nowhere，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 无处（作表语，说明处所或去向：the trowel was nowhere）
C. adv. 哪里也不（置于句首：Nowhere, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 哪里也不（作后置定语，紧跟被修饰的名词：the trowel nowhere）
E. adv. 哪里也不（作介词宾语：from nowhere）
F. adv. 哪里也不（句首强调，引起全部倒装：Nowhere came the apprentice）
G. adv. 无处（被动结构中置于过去分词之后：be planted nowhere at the bed）
H. adv. 无处（be nowhere 说明所在或去向：everybody be nowhere before the rains）

answers.why: nowhere 意为“哪里也不”，此处置于句首交代地点或去向：Nowhere, in 1970 …。
nowhere 意为“无处”，此处置于宾语之后作状语：had carried the trowel nowhere。
nowhere 意为“无处”，此处作表语说明那件小小的花铲的去向或所在：was nowhere。
nowhere 意为“哪里也不”，此处作后置定语紧跟名词：the trowel nowhere。
nowhere 意为“哪里也不”，此处作介词 from 的宾语：from nowhere。
nowhere 意为“哪里也不”，此处置于句首引起全部倒装：Nowhere came the apprentice。
nowhere 意为“无处”，被动结构中副词置于过去分词之后：be planted nowhere at the bed。
nowhere 意为“无处”，be nowhere 说明众人须在雨季前到达某处或处于某状态。
nowhere 意为“无处”，1980 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次搬运那件小小的花铲，副词置于句末。
nowhere 意为“哪里也不”，母亲 1982 年那句话以地点状语开头：Nowhere, …。
